title: Hearty Spanish Vegetable Gazpacho
description: A fermented and crumbly Spanish dish featuring red chilli and tadka, made in a ceramic tagine, this gazpacho is a satvik-friendly and adventurous meal option. It combines the flavors of Spain with the warmth of Indian spices.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a ceramic tagine, combine the diced red bell pepper, red chilli, cucumber, tomato, and red onion.
Drizzle the olive oil over the vegetables and sprinkle the tadka spice blend evenly.
Roast the vegetables in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until they are tender.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Use an immersion blender to puree the roasted vegetables until they are coarsely chopped.
Stir in the minced garlic and apple cider vinegar, if using.
Season the gazpacho with salt to taste.
Cover the tagine and refrigerate the gazpacho for at least 2 hours to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the gazpacho chilled, garnished with chopped fresh herbs or a dollop of yogurt, if desired.
